unreg:tournament_player_milestone.mechanism: The event is a union over every player-game of the tournament, play-in games included (the First Four in 2026; the rules' play-in clause must be re-read for 2027, when the 76-team field has 12 Opening Round games and 24 play-in teams). Each player-game's chance is a far-tail probability of his stat distribution given minutes, usage, opponent and game script; exposure is the number of games his team survives. A few high-usage scorers or versatile rebound-and-assist players hold most of the mass, so the outcome depends on which teams make the field, how far they advance, star availability, blowout truncation, overtime and the stat source.

attach.why: Play-in inclusion (First Four in the 2026 text; Opening Round for the 2027 field) and the five eligible triple-double categories are set here.
